headings.html: Putting your ISP at the heart of your digital life

paragraphs.text: MenuOpenAVNAI antivirus platform that evolves to combat malwareVisit SiteOpenAVN are building the future of online protection.

paragraphs.html: They have a powerful vision to be the storehouse of knowledge for products against malware; already amassing over 300 terabytes of virus definitions.
paragraphs.text: They have a powerful vision to be the storehouse of knowledge for products against malware; already amassing over 300 terabytes of virus definitions.

paragraphs.text: CategoryBrand + WebsiteDate2020First things firstOpenAVN came to us as a seed stage startup - building a powerful but complex anti-malware product. They'd bootstrapped their branding but now needed a partner to take it to the next level—creating a brand to inspire investors and captivate users.

paragraphs.html: Our first step was to gain a deep understanding of OpenAVN and their market.
paragraphs.text: Our first step was to gain a deep understanding of OpenAVN and their market.

paragraphs.html: Through stakeholder interviews and desktop research we dove into cybersecurity; analysing OpenAVN’s vision, business strategy,  technical advantages, and audience needs.
paragraphs.text: Through stakeholder interviews and desktop research we dove into cybersecurity; analysing OpenAVN’s vision, business strategy,  technical advantages, and audience needs.

paragraphs.html: In collaborative workshops we surfaced OpenAVN’s points of difference and core values.
paragraphs.text: In collaborative workshops we surfaced OpenAVN’s points of difference and core values.

paragraphs.html: We laid out the functional benefits that would compel people to trial the products; and the emotional benefits to weave this software into their daily lives.
paragraphs.text: We laid out the functional benefits that would compel people to trial the products; and the emotional benefits to weave this software into their daily lives.

paragraphs.html: We wanted new users to feel - "the confidence to operate in an online world".
paragraphs.text: We wanted new users to feel - "the confidence to operate in an online world".

paragraphs.html: OpenAVN have AI-based nodes around the world that search for new patterns emerging in viruses, allowing them to update for new malware in days not weeks.
paragraphs.text: OpenAVN have AI-based nodes around the world that search for new patterns emerging in viruses, allowing them to update for new malware in days not weeks.

paragraphs.html: We explored hundreds of names, words, and concepts around protection, security, defence and intelligence before zeroing in on the first product – Brightscan, an antivirus app.
paragraphs.text: We explored hundreds of names, words, and concepts around protection, security, defence and intelligence before zeroing in on the first product – Brightscan, an antivirus app.

paragraphs.html: Brightscan evokes scanning the horizon for threats, and brightness as intelligence; a process that gets smarter with every scan.
paragraphs.text: Brightscan evokes scanning the horizon for threats, and brightness as intelligence; a process that gets smarter with every scan.

paragraphs.html: The OpenAVN logo has a feeling of active intelligence; we were inspired by ark-like projects such as the Svalbard Seed Vault. It's created from scan lines, echoing the constant analysis of data to find patterns.
paragraphs.text: The OpenAVN logo has a feeling of active intelligence; we were inspired by ark-like projects such as the Svalbard Seed Vault. It's created from scan lines, echoing the constant analysis of data to find patterns.

paragraphs.html: We drew inspiration from patterns in nature throughout the graphic elements, reflecting the pattern recognition at the heart of OpenAVN.
paragraphs.text: We drew inspiration from patterns in nature throughout the graphic elements, reflecting the pattern recognition at the heart of OpenAVN.

paragraphs.html: And we chose a deep blue for the master brand to feel established but which can house different products underneath it - with their own lighter, friendlier palettes.
paragraphs.text: And we chose a deep blue for the master brand to feel established but which can house different products underneath it - with their own lighter, friendlier palettes.

paragraphs.html: Antivirus websites are crowded with generic visuals – stock photography, connected dots, bright red shields, and bug shapes. OpenAVN wanted their site to tell a unique and visual story in this busy market, to cut through buzzwords, and show how they are harnessing new technology to vastly improve the speed of response to malware.
paragraphs.text: Antivirus websites are crowded with generic visuals – stock photography, connected dots, bright red shields, and bug shapes. OpenAVN wanted their site to tell a unique and visual story in this busy market, to cut through buzzwords, and show how they are harnessing new technology to vastly improve the speed of response to malware.

paragraphs.html: We needed to find a great balance of introducing the master brand of OpenAVN, at the same time as debuting their products, Brightscan and Torus – so we designed each product section to have its own feeling while living harmoniously within the rest of the site.
paragraphs.text: We needed to find a great balance of introducing the master brand of OpenAVN, at the same time as debuting their products, Brightscan and Torus – so we designed each product section to have its own feeling while living harmoniously within the rest of the site.

paragraphs.html: The site is built on CraftCMS, an API-driven CMS which provides a beautiful experience for both developers and content editors. Employing a modular design system, the site is flexible and easily updatable – allowing it to grow along with OpenAVN’s ambitious product roadmap. Our fluid approach to responsive ensures an ideal reading experience for visitors, whatever their screen size.
paragraphs.text: The site is built on CraftCMS, an API-driven CMS which provides a beautiful experience for both developers and content editors. Employing a modular design system, the site is flexible and easily updatable – allowing it to grow along with OpenAVN’s ambitious product roadmap. Our fluid approach to responsive ensures an ideal reading experience for visitors, whatever their screen size.

paragraphs.html: Interactive touches are employed throughout the site to engage and excite – the WebGL homepage experience shows endpoint threats around the world being identified and instantly contained, while an SVG animation used as a background pattern takes the brand’s logo shapes and sends “data” through it in animated bursts.
paragraphs.text: Interactive touches are employed throughout the site to engage and excite – the WebGL homepage experience shows endpoint threats around the world being identified and instantly contained, while an SVG animation used as a background pattern takes the brand’s logo shapes and sends “data” through it in animated bursts.

paragraphs.html: Our design team worked alongside OpenAVN’s product team to ensure their brand would be expressed where users interact with it the most – in their products. We co-designed the Brightscan and Torus interfaces with striking, bold colours and clean layouts to provide at-a-glance clarity on users’ device status. With OpenAVN everything happens powerfully in the background; so we wanted people to feel visually reassured that their devices are secured, at all times.
